import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long add(long x, long y) {
        return (x + y) % MOD;
    }

    static long sub(long x, long y) {
        x -= y;
        return (x < 0) ? x + MOD : x;
    }

    static long mult(long x, long y) {
        return (x * y) % MOD;
    }

    static long modpow(long x, long p) {
        if (p == 0) return 1;
        if ((p & 1) == 1) return mult(x, modpow(x, p - 1));
        long half = modpow(x, p >> 1);
        return mult(half, half);
    }

    static long modinv(long x) {
        return modpow(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static int n;
    static List<List<Long>> A = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[][][] T;
    static List<Map<Long, Long>> DP = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] family;
    static int[] family_id;
    static List<List<Integer>> family_mask;

    static void calc() {
        family_mask = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            family_mask.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        family = new int[1 << n];
        family_id = new int[1 << n];

        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            family[mask] = family[mask >> 1] + (mask & 1);
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            int k = family[mask];
            family_id[mask] = family_mask.get(k).size();
            family_mask.get(k).add(mask);
        }

        T = new long[n + 1][];
        for (int k = 0; k <= n; ++k) {
            int size = family_mask.get(k).size();
            T[k] = new long[size][1 << n];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
                int cm = family_mask.get(k).get(i);
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
                    long ans = 0;
                    if ((mask & cm) == mask) continue;
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                        if ((cm & (1 << x)) != 0) continue;
                        if ((mask & (1 << x))) {
                            int newmask = cm | (1 << x);
                            ans |= (1L << family_id[newmask]);
                        }
                    }
                    T[k][i][mask] = ans;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            A.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(parts[j]);
                val = mult(val, modinv(100));
                A.get(i).add(val);
            }
        }
        calc();

        // Initialize DP
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            DP.add(new HashMap<>());
        }
        DP.get(0).put(1L, 1L);

        for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
            Map<Long, Long> currentDP = DP.get(k);
            Map<Long, Long> nextDP = DP.get(k + 1);
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentDP.entrySet()) {
                long mask = entry.getKey();
                long val = entry.getValue();

                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    long aVal = A.get(k).get(i);
                    if (((mask >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                        prob = mult(prob, aVal);
                    } else {
                        prob = mult(prob, sub(1, aVal));
                    }
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < family_mask.get(k).size(); ++i) {
                    if (((mask >> i) & 1) != 0) continue;
                    long newmask = 0;
                    long p = mult(prob, val);
                    for (int j = 0; j < family_mask.get(k).size(); ++j) {
                        if (((mask >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                            newmask |= T[k][j][(int) (mask)];
                        }
                    }
                    if (newmask != 0) {
                        nextDP.put(newmask, add(nextDP.getOrDefault(newmask, 0L), p));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(DP.get(n).getOrDefault(1L, 0L));
    }
}
